name: Rizuhble's Trash Lobber Rat King
rows: Sell it once you're out of slots.
Its weapon damage raises your grenade damage.
Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Battle Vest.
Only if they have a real gun hero: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta, Vyper.
One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.
Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.
A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Mo & Krill's Combo.
Stuns and silences that stop your ult.
Sell Battle Vest for this, or Hollow Point if a counter took it.
On Scrap Grenade. Sell Cultist Sacrifice for this.
You keep dropping under 65% health in fights.
Buy instead of Battle Vest. Rat bites cut their bullet resist, so throw rats before the grenade.
changes: Round 13: new grenade-spam build — sources (grenade style only): lockbuilds 'BOMB ISLAND ICED TEA [Echo Shard Scrap Bomb]' (Oct 8): High-Velocity, Monster Rounds, Cultist Sacrifice, Battle Vest, Enduring Speed, Long Range, Sharpshooter ('increases the damage nicely on the bomb, since you're often away from enemies'); 'make it bigger' Superior Cooldown, Mystic Expansion, Ballistic Enchantment; Echo Shard 'when you're ready'; more damage Glass Cannon, Berserker; more health Witchmail, Juggernaut, Colossus. lockbuilds 'Ratm Bomb' (Oct 7): Monster Rounds, Opening Rounds, Cultist; greens Extra Health, Sprint Boots, Enduring Speed, Fortitude; Compress Cooldown, Superior Cooldown. Kit: Scrap Grenade does bullet damage (70 + 0.6x weapon damage bonus per detonation, +70 at T2, +1 detonation and a 300 big blast at T3, cooldown 26s to 18s at T1), so weapon damage items scale it and spirit lifesteal doesn't heal off it. No Extra Charge: the grenade has no charges in the files (only Rat Swarm does). Order: kit-based, grenade maxed first (its T1 cooldown, T2 damage and T3 big blast are the whole build), then cape, ult, rats; no grenade-build order is published.

Round 14: Glass Cannon out (Kieran's standing rule: no Glass Cannon on Rat King; not in mobalytics' Rat King late items either) for Colossus, the BOMB ISLAND build's 'more health' pick (+15% weapon damage feeds the grenade, +25% base health grows the cape). Long Range and Sharpshooter moved before Battle Vest: gun 4.8k now 5.6k souls (was 8.8k) and lands 6.4k exactly on Sharpshooter at 6.4k; health 4.8k now on Fortitude at 12.8k (lands 6.4k). Ability order now the mobalytics grenade-max-first grid path 1324113313444222 (was a kit-only guess). Siphon Bullets out for Greater Expansion (BOMB ISLAND's 'make it bigger' group; Siphon isn't in any grenade build checked and its steal needs bullet hits): +30% radius on an 8m grenade, so it hits more heroes and Ballistic Enchantment stacks per hero hit. Counterspell example now confirmed parryable.

Round 17: made clearly the ranged grenade build: Berserker (needs you to soak 120 damage a stack, the tank build's item) → Hollow Point, same 3.2k gun slot: +35% weapon damage while above 65% health, which a thrower standing 15m+ back (Long Range/Sharpshooter) keeps, so +21 per detonation on the grenade (70 + 0.6x weapon damage). Spikes unchanged.

Round 21: put back (Kieran plays and likes this build); style and core unchanged. New full late list to ~73k net: Transcendent Cooldown (moved up from Slot locked: the grenade is the build, 26s→18s at T1), Glass Cannon (+80% weapon damage, the grenade does 70 + 0.6x weapon damage per detonation; Kieran's own Pest Control last big buy), Mystic Reverb on the grenade (imbue: hits of 100+ add 50% of the damage again in 16m, 6.25s cooldown; 140+ per detonation from grenade T2), Cheat Death and Refresher as luxuries last. Each sells the weakest item left (Battle Vest, Cultist Sacrifice, Hollow Point, Greater Expansion). Counters caption in the required format.

Round 23: base kept (Kieran's tested build). New swap box: Bullet Resist Shredder for Battle Vest when you keep dropping under 65% health (Battle Vest's bonus turns off there). Rat bites are spirit damage, so they apply the shredder's -10% bullet resist, and the grenade and ult deal bullet damage.
Round 25: points reordered for the grenade build: Grenade T1, T2 and T3 by about L13, Pestments T1/T2 after, ult tiers next, rats last.
Slot locked: Transcendent Cooldown moved out of the rich box (Kieran rule: tiny-gain expensive upgrades are Slot locked).

Relevance pass (Kieran Oct 22: range items don't raise grenade damage): game files give Scrap Grenade 70 per detonation + 0.6x EBaseWeaponDamageIncrease (ult 200 + 1.2x), and that stat is only the plain Weapon Damage % (BaseAttackDamagePercent) plus the soul-investment bonus. Long Range's 40 and Sharpshooter's 60 are a separate long-range bullet bonus (MODIFIER_VALUE_LONG_RANGE_BULLET_DAMAGE_INCREASE), and High-Velocity's bullet speed doesn't touch the grenade (its own 1300/1500 projectile), so High-Velocity (+4.8 per detonation), Long Range (+0) and Sharpshooter (+6) out. Close Quarters (+20) and Point Blank (+50) were checked as Kieran suggested and rejected: their bonus is the same kind of separate range bonus (MODIFIER_VALUE_CLOSE_RANGE_WEAPON_DAMAGE_INCREASE), not Weapon Damage %, so the grenade formula gives them +0 too; whether either range bonus applies to grenade hits at all is untested (sandbox scenario ratking_grenade_range_bonus, no evidence file yet: inconclusive, so neither goes in). In: Extended Magazine → Titanic Magazine (+14% = +8.4 per detonation for 1.6k, vs Sharpshooter's +10% for 3.2k), Hollow Point moved to right after Fortitude. Gun 4.8k at 4.8k souls (was 5.6k), health 4.8k at 11.2k (was 12.8k), gun 8k exactly on Hollow Point at 14.4k; Weapon Damage at 6.4k souls 88% (was 74%), at 14.4k 139% (was 92%). Core 43.2k (was 44.8k), 12 slots.
